tei:div.tei:p: gzigs sprod/ rgyud kyi dka' 'grel tshigs bcad ma yin lags/ sdom pa rtsa rgyud kyi nges don 'chad na 'di med ka med pa yin kyang*/ sngon chad phal gyis ma ma rnyed pa/ bdag kun dga' snying pos bsod nams kyi bgo skal byon pa lags so/ / dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig bde ba'i gnas thob pa/ /'grib med 'byor pa dam pa ste/ /gzhan ni sna tshogs 'di dag la/ /'khor lo skor ba bzhin du 'grub/ /srid pa gsum du dus gyur pa/ /de dag thos la brten par byed/ /gzhung mang klog pas ngal ba dag /snying po'i gnas la ngal gso zhig /he ru ka dpal 'byung ba la/ /bla ma mchog gis 'di ston te/ /gzhan dang bstan bcos thos pa yi/ /snyems pa yis ni ci zhig bya/ /shes rab mchog gi rdo rje can/ /mtha' bzhi rnam par grol ba bzhed/ /mtshan ma rtsol ba 'di med de/ /'di ni snying po bsdus pa yis/ /med pa las kyi thams cad skyes/ /nam mkha' la sogs 'byung ba dang*/ /'gro ba drug po lhan cig skyes/ /'di ni snying po bsdus pa yin/ /lhan skyes 'gro ba'i bdag nyid de/ / bde ba nyid de lhan cig skyes/ /gnyis med gnyis su med pa'i tshul/ /'di ni snying po bsdus pa yin/ /zhi ba kun 'gro gnas pa ste/ /'gyur med 'gyur ba'i dri ma bral/ /gzhan las ma yin rang la gnas/ /'di ni snying po bsdus pa yin/ / gzung ba 'dzin pa spros pa dag /gang la gnyis med gnas su bzhugs/ /rlung gi 'khor lo phyin ci log /'di ni bya ba'i snying po'o/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'od 'phro ba/ /klog gi gzugs can sgra yi tshul/ /bde ba phun tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /bya ba'i snying por de bshad do/ / bdud rtsi dam pa'i thig le ni/ /dri bral ri bong 'dzin dang mnyam/ /rnam shes ye shes gnyis med pa/ /'di ni bya ba'i snying po yin/ /gang du lus ngag sems med pa/ /de ni de nyid gsum du gnas/ /nam mkha' bzhin du gos pa med/

/bsgrub bya sgrub byed snying po'o/ /bya ba rim pa bzhi yin te/ /ba sgrub par bya ba de nyid bzhi/ /bsgrub bya sgrub byed dbyer med pa/ /snying po bsdus par de bshad do/ / slob dpon gzhan dag 'dod pa ni/ kha cig 'dod chags chags pa nyid/ /de bzhin dbang gi gnas su yang*/ /gzhan dag de las steng du 'dod/ /de bzhin nor bur gnas pa yang*/ /'ga' zhig phyin ci log tu sbyor/ / 'ga' zhig mkha' dang mtshungs zhes zer/ /brgyal ba'i gnas skabs 'dod pa gzhan/ /rtog pa'i sgom pa'ang 'dod pa ste/ /phal cher de dag phyin ci log / bzang po gzhan dag 'dod pa ni/ kha cig ro mnyam ye shes te/ /zab dang gsal ba zhes kyang 'dod/ /gzhan dag sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ /'ga' zhig bde chen gzugs zhes zer/ /de dag 'gal min tha dad yin/ /brtul zhugs zhal snga'i bzhed pa ni/ /dpyid dang thig le sbyor ba ste/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na/ / rang byung ngo bo nyid ces bya/ /dpyid ni bde ba'i gzugs yin te/ /thig le de yang sna tshogs nyid/ /lhan cig skyes pa kun 'gro nyid/ /rang byung nyid ni 'gyur bral lo/ /de ltar shes nas dngos kun gyi/ /bla ma dam pa gnyis bstain na/ / longs spyod grol ba thob 'gyur te/ /snying po bsdus par de bshad do/ / he ru ka dpal mngon brjod pa/ /'di nyid kho na der brjod de/ /rin chen phung po sna tshogs pa/ /der ni 'di las gzhan yod min/ /rdo rje'i tshig ni dbye dka' ste/ /don gyi rnam pa du ma dag /spyod pa'i zhal snga las brgyud pa/ /snying po tsam zhig bsdu bar bya/ /lha mo yis ni gsol btab nas/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po he ru kas/ /drwa ba 'khor lo'i dbus gsungs zhes/ /slob dpon phal cher sgrog par byed/ /lha mo thig le 'byed byed ste/ /rtsa rnams drwa ba gang ba las/ /dpyid kyi g.yo ba'i sgra yin na/ /de lta na yang legs pa nyid/ /dpa' bo bye ba rnams kyis 'di/

/dus gcig tu ni nges brjod pas/ /zhu ba po dang lan med ces/ /nag po'i zhal snga nas kyis bzhed/ /mdor bsdus pa ni dang po ste/ /rgyas pa nyid kyis bstan pa'o/ / gnas la sogs pa bstan pa nas/ /brtsams te phyi ma bsdus pa'o/ /dang por rkang pa drug yin te/ /'di yi dgos pa la sogs bshad/ /de yi 'og tu rkang pa drug /gleng gzhi yis ni mdor bstan pa'o/ /e zhes bya ba de bzhin nyid/ /srog chags kun la gnas pa yi/ /bde ba lhan cig skyes par brjod/ / de nyid thams cad snang bar snang*/ /baṃ yig brjod pa gang gang du/ /rab tu rig cing rang myong ba/ /'dzin pa po dang rig gzhi med/ /de ni yod dang med las 'das/ /de 'og ma yig zhes brjod pa/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa yi/ /sgra yi de nyid zhes brjod ste/ /sna tshogs du ma'i skad du sbyar/ /de nas de las slar yang ya/ /dbang po'i drwa ba ji bzhin gzugs/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /'di ni de las yang snang ngo*/ /lhan cig skyes pa dang po ste/ /de las gsang ba gsum 'byung ba/ /dngos dang dngos med ma lus pa'i/ /rang bzhin de nyid ces bya'o/ / thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /tshig bcu yis ni bshad pa dag /gsang ba chen po'i thig ler ni/ /brtul zhugs spyod 'chang nyid kyis bshad/ /sgra tshul phag mor bshad pa ste/ /dam tshig dpa' bor rjes su dran/ /dus gsum dag ni gnas gsum khyab/ /gnyis med sbyor ba mtshon bya'o/ /bsrubs pa sgrub byed nyid yin te/ /mdor bstan pas kyang nyan par gyis/ /bar ma la sogs gsum yin te/ /rdzas dang gsang ba ye shes so/ /a wa dhū tīr brjod pa dang*/ /'bar ba dang ni 'bar ba che/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i pho nya mo/ /grub pa rnam pa gsum du brjod/ /thig le yi ni mchod la sogs/ /gang la yon tan bsngags pa yi/ / de'i 'og tu thabs bzhi bstan/ /tshogs kyi spyod pa'i dngos grub dang*/ /de 'og mchod pa chen po bzhi/

/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*/ /dngos po'i rnam par rtog pa rnams/ /lhan cig skyes pas bcing bar bya/ /de yang rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /gnyis gnyis dbang po snyoms 'jug dang*/ /snyoms 'jug de nyid 'dzin pa'o/ /gnas kyi khyad par nges bstan pa/ /ri bo la sogs phyi rol te/ /'khor lo sogs ni gsang bar spyod/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gnas gyur pa/ / de yang gzhan du brjod pa yin/ /de nas dkyil 'khor legs gsungs pa/ / dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum po'o/ / sum cu rtsa bdun rtsa rnams ni/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor mchog tu gsungs/ /'khor lo bzhi las skyes pa yi/ /rtsa yang dkyil 'khor zhes brjod do/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i khams rnams ni/ /rnam par dag pa mchod par bshad/ /sgo rnams la ni dris bsangs te/ /bum pa 'god par gang gsungs pa/ /bu ga brgyad la gnas pa'i rtsa/ /rab tu thim pa'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /'khor lo gsum la gnas pa rnams/ /rnam bcu sa yi dbang phyug yin/ /slar yang ma mo rnams bshad pa/ /de nyid dang po tha mar khyab/ /dri chab pho nya zhes bshad ste/ / khrag ni me tog zhes su brjod/ /rdul 'byed pa ni bdug pa ste/ kha sbyor mar mer shes par bya/ /brgya phrag rigs las byung ba yi/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa// khams dang phung po la sogs pa'ang*/ /brgya phrag grangs kyis phye ba yin/ /bdud rtsi lnga las ye shes ni/ /steng du bsgreng ba rgyal mtshan te/ /de bzhin sna tshogs de'i rnam pa/ /gsang ba mchog gi rim pa las/ /'di la dkyil 'khor rnam bshad pa/ /tha dad so so gsal ba yin/ /gang las shes rab gsal 'gyur ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor bstan pa lhan cig skyes/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas brtsams te/ /rab tu 'bar ba chen po yin/ /chos kyi sku yi 'khor lo gang*/ /bcom pa gdong g.yogs phye bar brjod/ khrag chen po ni mgrin pa ste/ /'di la lam gsum zlog par bshad/ /me ma thal mo yin par bshad/ /me tog dor bar gang gsungs pa/

/de ni 'bar ba nyid yin te/ /gang las dar ras legs bkab pa/ /mthong ba bcings par gyur pa ni/ /gnyis med ma yi lam gang yin/ /shin tu bkag par gyur pa'o/ / skor ba tshangs pa'i me gnas su/ /dung gi dbyings la rnam par gnas/ / pho brang nyams dga' sprul pa yin/ /bde chen he ru ka yi ni/ /gnas su yang dag shes par bya/ /mi choms pa dang 'brel bas na/ /de yi rigs ni gnyid mar bshad/ /ming bstan khu ba 'bab pa yin/ khyim ni bha ga zhes gsungs te/ / dpa' bo chen po der 'gro'o/ /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /nyon mongs bshig pas 'jig pa'o/ /'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ /de bzhin sngags kyi dkyil 'khor sogs/ /dang po'i bsdoms su gsal ba yin/ / de bzhin las kyi dbye ba las/ /rnam pa du mar gsungs gyur pa/ /gsang ba'i don ni rab tu sbas/ /'du shes bye ba gsod byed cing*/ /de nyid dag pa 'tsho bar brjod/ /ltung ba dgug pa yin par bshad/ /sha zas bzung ba gnas pa ste/ / thim pa gdon chen pos bzung ba'o/ /sgo gnyis las ni 'gro dang 'ong*/ /de ni rlung gi shugs kyis 'ong*/ /hi yig la ni rtog par bshad/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis la/ /gang 'dod 'gro ba der 'gyur ro/ / a wa dhū tī las 'ongs pa/ /sngags kyi dbab par de bshad do/ /yang ni ldog cing yang 'gro ba/ /dug gso ba yi las su bshad/ /rengs pa las ni rmongs chog ste/ /grol ba bde ba rig par brjod/ /'khor lo rnams kyi mngal gnas pa/ /brten pa 'pho bar 'dod pa yin/ /snying po khong stong las byung ba/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs 'byin te/ /dag pa las ni snang 'gyur zhing*/ / dag pa min las mi snang ba/ /sna tshogs 'dod pa'i gzugs yin no/ /tshig 'phrog la sogs gang bshad pa/ /dbang po las ni shes pa'o/ /bdun pa'i lus can khu ba ste/ /sngags ni rlung zhes brjod pa yin/ /de nyid brgyas lhag brgya yi ni/ /skye gnas dbus su bcing bar bya/

/de las lha yi lus su 'gyur/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang*/ /bde ba che dang raṇḍa ka /kun gyi spyi bor gnas pa ni/ /pho brang gnas kyi nang 'jug pa/ /rdo rje ra li brtul zhugs te/ /thig le gsum ni rdo rjer byed/ /khrag drang ba zhes bshad pa ni/ /bcu drug bde ba rig pa'o/ / cho ga mang po gzhan dag ni/ /re zhig bdag gi rnam par spangs/ /skye gnas 'og tu rtsa lnga ni/ /bong bu'i rnam pa khrag gi gdong*/ /'dir ni rgyu ba chad pa gang*/ /sna tshogs shes par skye ba yin/ /sngags bzlas pa ni zla ba gcig/sngags ni byang chub sems su brjod/ /gnas su de ni 'ongs pa'o/ /tstsho ma gcig pu sdig spangs ma'i/ /dbugs kyi rgyu bar bshad pa ste/ /yi ge mang po kla klo sgra/ / de yang 'khor lor spyod pa'o/ /rigs ldan gnyis spangs ma zhes bya/ /de yi thig le longs spyod nyid/ /g.yo ba kun tu spyod pa yin/ /rdul gyis nā da 'byed pa ni/ /rigs ldan ma yi mchod pa bzang*/ /gnyis gnyis las ni rtsa yi sgo/ /der yang rigs ldan ma rnams rgyu/ /gang yang thig le dngos po med/ /gang las rlung yang 'gog pa dang*/ /gang du rtsa yang rab tu dag /der ni gzhan dag yod min te/ /lhan skyes gci ga pu gsal ba'o/ / rtsa yi drwa ba thams cad la/ /a wa dhū tī g.yogs shing gnas/ /de 'dra de las kun 'byung ste/ /'byin dang sdud par byed pa mo/ /sna tshogs 'di ni gnyis med par/ /zhugs pa 'dres pa mo zhes brjod/ /bskyed bya dang ni skyed byed 'dres pa yang*/ /dang po rigs ldan rigs ldan mo zhes brjod/ /de yi 'phel ba ring du sgrub byed pa/ /de 'og de la mchod pa legs pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i skor ni 'o ma'i mdog /ser po smin mtshams gnas su ste/ /raṇḍa ka las sngo sangs nyid/ / lkog mar ston ka'i zla ba 'dra/ /brang ngos dkar dang dmar po ste/ /'dom bar las ni ljang ser bshad/ /lte ba'i dbus nas glog gi 'od/

/sgrib par byed pa gos yin te/ /chags sogs la ni gos su brjod/ /rab tu gsal bar snang ba gang*/ /sna tshogs du ma'i ngad du bsten/ /mdo sde rgyud dang rtog pa dag /gang du'ang rnyed par dka' ba yin/ /skye gnas mkha' 'gro ma yi ni/ /sa ni drug cu rtsa bzhir brjod/ /mgo bo las byung bdud rtsi lnga/ /gzugs can la sogs brgyad po ni/ /lte ba'i dbus su rnam rol ba/ /ā li kā li rab tu 'dres/ /sde tshan brgyad las byung ba yin/ /nyi mo rab tu 'phel ba'o/ /gzugs can ma la ku zhes brjod/ /'o byed ma ni tsha sogs yin/ /ṭu yig las ni lā mar brjod/ /ta sde yongs su gyur mar bshad/ /dum skyes ma dang mi ldog ma/ /su dang antastha zhes bya/ /e hi ka dang sdud byed ma/ / uṣma ṇa dang a ir brjod/ /gang 'di'i byed dang byed pa'i tshogs/ /de dag las kyi rnam 'gyur yin/ /kha yi lam ni thod par bshad/ /dgra sta bshang ba'i rtsa yin te/ /sna yi bu ga mche ba ru/ /de ni gnyis su bcings pa yin/ /'khor lo rtags su brjod pa ste/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni ral gri dag /rdo rje de bzhin dung zhes pa/ /gnyis gnyis mig dang rna ba yin/ /gang de dag la mchod byed de/ / mchod pa bde ba yin par bshad/ / khyad par las kyi pho nya mo/ /rnam pa brgyad du yang bshad pa/ /dmar ser nyi ma'i khams las byung*/ /zla ba las ni sngo zhing skya/ /rtse gsum dang ni mdung thung gang*/ /de ni 'bar ba'i mtshan mar bshad/ /'khor lo'i rnam pa sprin sngo ba/ /de ni rlung khams las gyur pa/ /mkha' khams rā hu lar brjod de/ /gnag dang dkar bar bshad pa yin/ /na ḍi stong phrag bco lnga ni/ /yongs su khyab par byed pa yin/ /ser zhing gser gyi mdog 'drar snang*/ /'byung po 'dzin byed las byung ba'o/ / sha ni bdud rtsi zhes su brjod/ /rnam shes las byung dus kyi me/ /gang gi dpral ba'i thig le dang*/ /mgo yi dbus su 'gro bar bshad/ /char sprin lta bur bshad pa ni/

/chu las byung ba'i 'bar byed de/ /g.yon gyi mche ba lug tu bshad/ /gang rnams 'di dag thams cad ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma ste sngags su brjod/ /lā ma'i rigs las byung ba lnga/ /'khor lo kun la gnas pa ste/ /rtag tu bha ga'i dbus gnas sam/ /ling ga'i dbus su rgyu bar byed/ /tsanḍa li ni stobs dang ldan/ /khu ba rdo rjer byed pa ste/ /de bzlog pa las khrag kyang ngo*/ / de yis sha dang lpags pa nyams/ khu bas rus pa 'joms pa te/ khrag dang khu ba'i sbyor ba las/ /mun pa skye zhing 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las rtsa dang rgyus pa dag /mun pa las ni me 'byung ste/ /zhag dang chu ser ba spu dang*/ /rkang dang tshil bu skra rnams te/ /de la sogs pa mang po'i khams/ /thams cad dag par byed pa nyid/ /snying ni rnam pa bzhi la brtag /gzhan rnams re re las byung ba'o/ / gang gis gcig ni yongs bcings pas/ /de dag thams cad rengs par 'gyur/ /lā ma pad ma'i rigs yin te/ /'jig rten dbang ni nor bur brjod// khrag 'thung rtag pa'i rigs su bshad/ khung bur snang ba stong pa ste/ /rdo rje'i rigs las gang gyur pa/ /rtag tu 'dod cing spro ba ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brjod do/ /rta yi rigs las gang gyur pa/ /de ni rdo rje phag mor brjod/ /

dga' ba'i skad cig grangs gang yin/ /tshes zhes kla klo'i skad du mdzad/ /grong khyer pa yi spyod pa kun/ /bla ma'i kha yi bstan par bya/ /de bzhin phyag rgya sna tshogs pa/ /re zhig 'dir ni ma bstan no/ / sngags kyi gsang ba sbas pa gang*/ /de ni snying stobs brgyad du drag / gzhan dag kyang ni dpa' bos gsungs/ /mdor bshad rgyas par ma yin no/ /sha chen dag ces gsungs pa ni/ /thams cad 'du byed kho na ste/ /'du byed gang la rnam 'jig pa/ /'od gsal bar ni de bshad do/ /khyi sha tshor bar bshad pa ste/ /lus kyi dngos po phag par brjod/ /khyim bya dmar chen du bshad do/ / bza' ba mtshan ma med pa ste/ /sbyin sreg lhan cig skyed pa yin/ /bde ba gtor ma'i brda yis bstan/ /dung dang mu tig nya phyis ni/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma'o/ /rnam par thar pa bzhi yi ni/ /lus la byung ba thod par brjod/ /'byung po lnga las byung ba yi/ /thig le phyugs zhes bya ba ste/ /khwa la sogs pa phyugs rnams ni/ /nyon mongs du ma yin par bshad/ /steng dang 'og gi sgo dag las/ / pho nya mo rnams dngos grub 'gyur/ /ba glang lhan dang lding ba dang*/ /skem byed rtsa gnas zhes bya ba/ /bde chen zhes bya 'byung po ni/ /rnam pa lnga ru bshad pa yin/ /bde ba nam mkha'i khams yin te/ /rus sbal rnam par shes pa'o/ / rlung rnams rab tu phra ba la/ /yang dag 'gro ba dngos grub nyid/ /zhal bzhi zhes bya gang bstan pa/ /mgon po thabs kyi bdag nyid yin/ /rig ma phyag gi ming yin te/ /de yang bzhi pa bzhi nyid do/ /gang zhig 'bum phrag la sogs pa/ /yang yang bzlas pa phyag tu brjod/ /gsang ba'i mchod dang bsnyen bkur ni/ /sngags kyi spyod pa'i de nyid te/ /pho nya gnyis med sbyin sreg gi /lha rnams kyi ni sku chen no/ /rtag pa dam pa mchog tu phra/ /phyag rgya rnams las 'di chen po/ /phyag rgya chos zhes bya ba las/ /dus min 'chi ba bslu ba ste/ /gang gzhan lus kyi spyod pa can/

/las kyi phyag rgya de yang ngo*/ /shin tu rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir/ /rnam par dbye ba dran pa bzhi/ /bdag tu phyin ci log pa la/ /nges par sbyar ba yin par bshad/ /mi dge'i chos ni tshar gcod cing*/ /gang zhig phan 'dogs brtson pa ni/ /dge ba la ste yang dag spong*/ /de ni rnam pa bzhi ru brjod/ /gzhan rnams gang dag byang chub phyogs/ /de dag rnams las dbye ba ste/ /sum cu bdun pa'i rtsa rnams ni/ /mchog gi lam du sbyar bar bya/ /raṇḍa ka gnas nas song ste/ /tshangs pa'i gnas la thug gi bar/ /byang chub sems kyis gang ba ste/ /de nyid phyag rgya'i mchod pa yin/ /rnal 'byor ye shes bla med pa/ / ma zhen 'khor bar 'khyams pa nyid/ /phung po dang ni skye mched rnams/ /gang gi dbang du 'gyur ba dang*/ /gang zhig sngags kyi khyad par las/ /rlung ni 'gog par bshad pa yin/ /sgron ma nya sha dang ni chang*/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis khams yin te/ /mtshan mo snang ba med par brjod/ /gang las skyes mched bcu gnyis ni/ / lus la gnas pa'i sgo dgu po/ /brgya dang rtsa brgyad ldan pa'i rlung*/ /sku dang de bzhin gsung dang thugs/ /thun gsum du ni mngon par brjod/ /'di la tshangs pa'i yul gyi sar/ /dpa' bo'i sgra ni mi choms pa/ /lnga bcu rtsa bzhi dag pa'o/ / yi ge mang dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /mgo ni blon por brjod pa stai/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi de las 'byung*/ /gang gi ro ni spyod pa'i phyir/ /longs spyod pa ni rgyal phran te/ / 'byung po nyi shu bram ze la/ /de sgra rigs kyi gtso bor grags/ /dpyid dang nā da nyid la 'o/ /skye gnas 'khor lo rgyal rigs te/ /dbang chen dang ni de bzhin chu/ /sreg bza' rlung dang zla ba dang*/ /nyi ma nam mkha' bdun du 'dod/ /nor la gsang bar spyod pa'i phyir/ /de 'og rje rigs yin par bshad/ /lnga po bdud rtsi'i ming yin no/ / de bzhin dmangs rigs bar pa ste/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa ni/

/ 'di la sreg blugs byed par bshad/ /raṇḍa g.yung mo mthar skyes ni/ /tha ma'i rigs su bstan pa yin/ /'di la gcig tu 'dres pa'i phyir/ /sreg blugs cig tu bya ba bshad/ /zhag grangs bye brag gsungs gyur pa/ /rig pa'i rtul zhugs de 'dod do/ / gzhan dag gang zhig sngar bshad dang*/ /gang zhig 'og tu ston gyur pa/ / las rgyas pa yi cho ga rnams/ /slob dpon zhal sngas btang snyoms mdzad/ /me tog dang ni chu bsres pa/ /sngags gsum gyi ni bya ba yi/ /lus kyi g.yo ba sgra dang ni/ /yid kyi brjod pa'i khyad par yin/ /mtshan mo rtag tu sha za ba/ /nges par shes rab pha rol phyin/ /glo bur sbyor ba 'di dag gis/ /the tshom med par thob par 'gyur/ /ha ha he he rnam pa brgyad/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sgra zhes dang*/ / lus la byung ba snying stobs so/ / dga' ba la sogs sa rnams ni/ /yid las byung ba rnam pa brgyad/ /sgrub po yis ni lha mnyes byas/ /gzugs ni brtan par gyur pa na/ /phyag rgya'i sbyor ba la zhugs pas/ /sngags kyi spyod pa spyad par bya/ /lha rnams kyi ni ring gzigs nas/ /sgrub la byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur/ /bskyed pa'i rim la gnas pas kyang*/ /'di ni the tshom med pa yin/ /skyes bu'am shes rab las byung ba'i/ khu ba me tog zhes pa ste/ /snyim pa bkang ba dgag pa yin/ /'di la rig pa 'dzin pa yi/ /gtso bo khrag 'thung bka' yis 'gyur/ /yang na bya ba thams cad ni/ /ji bzhin nyid du sgrub par byed/ /lus kyi sbyor ba dang po ste/ /de bzhin gnyis pa nus pa yin/ /gsum pa dag ni phyi yi nyid/ /bzhi pa yis ni dmigs pa med/ /sngags kyi rgyal po grub par 'gyur/ /khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'o/ /'gro ba kun la khyab gyur pa/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir brjod pa ni/ /dbugs kyi dbye ba zad min pa/ /bud med stong phrag nyi shu gcig /de yang drug brgyas lhag pa'o/ / ji snyed rtsa yi grangs kyi ni/

/rlung yang de snyed gnas pa dang*/ /rgyu ba ma yin mi rgyu min/ /khams kyi rnam pa'ang de nyid do/ / de dag lus la rnam gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang sems dpa' yi/ /ci phyir bsgrub bya sgrub ce na/ /'khor lo'i bdag nyid sbyor ba'o/ /thog ma tha ma'i tshig dag la/ /lha mo bzhi zhes gnas pa ni/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo bzhi po la/ /steng dang 'og tu rnam gnas pa'o/ / dpal ldan he ru ka yi rgyud/ /spang bar bya ba ma yin pa/ /rgyud ni rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /de spong ba ni mi mkhas pa'o/ /kun tu gnas pa'i snying po ni/ /rab tu rgya che bstan pa dang*/ /sngon nas shin tu rnam dag pa/ /gsal dang 'phro ba'i rang bzhin no/ /dag dang shin tu rnam dag pa'i/ /shrī he ru ka'i rnam pa ni/ /nges dang mthun pa'i yid byed kyi/ /gzhi zhes bya ba dngos po'i rgyud/ /gang zhig dbugs dbyung gnyis gsungs pa/ /dbugs phyin pa nas yang dag thob/ /'khor ba ji srid zhugs pa ni/ /mi phrogs 'bras bu yin par brjod/ / lhan cig skyes pa rin po che/ /phal cher rgyud du sbas pa yin/ /bla ma'i man ngag dran pa'i phyir/ /yang dag snying po bsdus pa'o/ / g.yo ba rlung gi de kho na/ /sna tshogs las rnams byed pa ni/ /rdo rje sku yi bshad pa ste/ /rtsa ba'i sngags su brjod pa yin/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsum po/ /dag pa'i dkyil 'khor snang ba can/ /chos kyi sgo yi rjes ston pa/ /gsung ni snying po brjod par bya/ /rnam pa bdun gyi rab dbye can/ /sdug spangs bde ba sbyin byed cing*/ /thugs ni sdug bsngal ngal gso ba/ /gsang sngags nye ba'i snying po yin/ /bde bas bde ba thob 'gyur ba/ /sangs rgyas bde chen bde ba'i mchog /nam yang gzhig tu med pa ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi go char brjod/ /de nyid rnam pa lnga po ni/ /gzugs rnams kun la rab tu gnas/ /yi ge ha lnga'i sbyor ba yis/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor bde thob 'gyur/

/dngos grub thams cad skyed byed pa/ /rnal 'byor ma yi snying po ni/ /'byin dang sdud par byed pa yi/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo gsang ba'o/ / gang yang mchog tu zab mo yi/ /chos la mos par byed de yang*/ /dpa' bo rang nyid dang mtshungs shes/ /thugs kyi rdo rje bka' bstsal to/ /don rnams kyi ni mdo tsam ste/ /snying po cung zad bsdus pa las/ /dri med legs pa gang thob des/ /khrag 'thung dpal gyi gnas thob shog /ces pa snying po bsdus pa slob dpon nag po spyod pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta ku ma ra dang*/ lo tsā ba rig pa gzhon nus bsgyur pa'o// // maṅga laṃ// gzhung 'di snar thar dang zha lu'i bstan 'gyur bsdus pa'i dus ma rnyed bstan 'gyur thams cad de gnyis las gyes pas bstan 'gyur phal cher la mi bzhugs/ phyis gong ma tshes lnga bas rnyed nas gsar du dpe bzhengs sne gdong gi bstan 'gyur rnying pa'i nang du bcug 'dug /'dir de dang*/ de'i ma dpe yin nam snyam pa'i dpe rnying hrul bo gcig rnyed pa las bshus pa/ 'di dang 'gyur mi gcig pa zhig gi dpe rnying par rked gcig kyang mthong ngo*// // shu bhaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/snying po bsdus pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 24 - - PAGE 23 -- PAGE 10 -
